contracts.genre_contract: Make the central desire, resistance and consequence legible through behavior. Build emotional meaning from choices, relationships and subtext rather than automatic tragedy.
contracts.style_contract: Interpret realism as a coherent photographic and physical presentation of the approved world, not as a ban on speculative content. Preserve the story, genre, identities and established world exceptions.
contracts.combination_logic: Drama owns the story logic and Realistic owns the presentation; neither changes the other's domain, and the project's locks win over both.
